title: From Grief to Survivor: Kristina Mills on Losing Her Mother and Finding Hope
summary: Kristina Mills thought she was simply watching an episode of Survivor. Instead, it became the catalyst for a life-changing decision. After battling postpartum depression, losing her mother to addiction, and feeling trapped in a season of grief, Kristina made a bold choice to pursue something that scared her. That decision eventually led her to compete on Survivor 49 in Fiji. In this episode, Kristina shares the deeply personal story behind that journey, the impact her mother's life and death had on her family, and what she learned about resilience, healing, and hope. She also discusses her work helping students prepare for meaningful careers through the University of Oklahoma's graduate business programs and how AI is reshaping the future workforce. This conversation is a reminder that grief may ride along with us, but it doesn't have to drive our lives.
